description: Zephyr Scale on self-hosted Jira Server/DC: test cases, cycles, executions, plans and attachments
name: io.github.vilaabo/zephyr-scale-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Jira base URL without a trailing slash, e.g. https://jira.example.com
environmentVariables.name: JIRA_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Jira Data Center Personal Access Token (used when JIRA_AUTH=pat, the default)
environmentVariables.name: JIRA_PAT

environmentVariables.description: Project key used when a tool is called without projectKey
environmentVariables.name: ZEPHYR_DEFAULT_PROJECT_KEY

environmentVariables.description: true registers 11 UNOFFICIAL tools backed by the internal /rest/tests/1.0 API the vendor does not support: editing a test cycle in place (rename/move, add/remove/reorder its cases), editing or DELETING individual executions, linking a cycle to a test plan, the folder tree, folder deletion, exact status names and custom field definitions
environmentVariables.name: ZEPHYR_ALLOW_INTERNAL_API

environmentVariables.description: false allows self-signed certificates (disables TLS verification)
environmentVariables.name: JIRA_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED

environmentVariables.description: Timeout of a single HTTP request in milliseconds (default 30000)
environmentVariables.name: JIRA_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Retries for GET requests and for 429/503 responses, honoring Retry-After (default 2)
environmentVariables.name: JIRA_MAX_RETRIES

environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug | info | warn | error (default info; all logs go to stderr)
environmentVariables.name: ZEPHYR_LOG_LEVEL
